title: Festive film season is back 🎄🍫
description:
Festive film season is back on the farmhouse table.

The red Meltie Mini Fondue Mug on a farmhouse kitchen table: malt balls in, tealight lit, strawberries dipped and dripping. A mini chocolate fondue in one mug for movie nights, cosy evenings and gifts.
